item.title: Nvidia halts server shipments to Southeast Asia
item.description: Nvidia has told ​its manufacturing partners ‌to stop shipping servers containing its chips to Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore and Indonesia, the Financial Times reported ​on Thursday.

item.title: Why a gin and tonic beats the collection basket
item.description: When I lived in a small village in Spain many years ago, my young son asked me a question one Sunday as we walked out of Mass. “Dad, why does everyone put only a few coins in the basket?”

item.title: New US tariffs worry Thai exporters
item.description: Business executives and analysts have voiced concerns over a fresh round of US tariffs targeting excess factory capacity and industrial subsidies across 16 major trading partners including Thailand, saying the move could lead to a new trade tussle.

item.title: Court decision on NBTC chairman delayed
item.description: A final court judgement over the status of National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) chairman Dr Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck could be delayed after the Supreme Administrative Court forwarded the dispute to the Constitutional Court, according to an informed source at the regulator.
